structuredContent.body:
Platform's frozen Builds 4.38.3 candidate is now available at `9f43cefe11bd246ce0de1cd0740261b557c0c7a0`, but its manual workflow cannot be dispatched until registered on the default branch.

This adds only `.github/workflows/tuple-ci.yml`, byte-for-byte from that reviewed candidate, on current main `f60f2c7596b1fa3010c91d1d546c71600da24715`. The workflow checks out the explicit full candidate SHA, verifies the exact published Builds source/tool artifacts, builds package-only Release, runs its scoped 82-case preflight and 14 binding controls, and retains successful or failed evidence. Permissions are read-only; the sole trigger is `workflow_dispatch`.

Validation: exact workflow bytes verified; YAML and embedded shell syntax passed; whitespace and pinned commitlint passed. No dependencies or current main source are changed. Registering/running this preflight grants no candidate, runtime, publication, or consumer acceptance; story 6.4 remains in progress.

Authorized scope: user approved branch push, default-branch workflow registration, and exact-candidate CI. The ruleset requires review and identifies the repository owner's configured bypass; any use of that exception must be recorded separately from policy-bound candidate acceptance.
structuredContent.title: ci(platform): register exact-candidate tuple preflight
